## 2025-05-22 - CSS Injection in Chart component
**Vulnerability:** The `ChartStyle` component used `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` to inject a `<style>` tag containing unsanitized `id`, configuration keys, and color values. This allowed an attacker to inject arbitrary CSS or break out of the `<style>` tag to execute XSS.
**Learning:** Even internal-looking IDs (like those generated by `useId`) can be overridden via props, and dynamic CSS generation is a high-risk area for injection vulnerabilities if not handled with strict allow-listing or sanitization.
**Prevention:** Always sanitize any dynamic data being injected into CSS selectors, property names, or values. Use restrictive regex (e.g., `[^a-zA-Z0-9-_]`) and quote attribute selectors in CSS to prevent breakout.
